jobs.style: FLAT MINIMALIST 2D animation exactly like the attached board and frame: clean geometric shapes, no outlines, soft long shadows, night panel-block city with warm yellow windows, palette graphite-violet #3A3550/#24212F, window yellow #E8B04B, lime #C6F432, white, alarm red #FF5A4E. jobs.prompt: Vertical 9:16 cover. In the upper-middle part, huge bold typography in three lines: small white «ПРЕДСТАВЬ:», then a giant lime «0 ₽», then white «И 30 ДНЕЙ»; under it a small yellow rounded badge «ДЕНЬ 1». Below the title, the faceless hero sits on the edge of a bed in a dark room by a window with the night city, holding a smartphone whose screen glows alarm red (no readable text on the screen), red light on the hero. Keep all text between 22% and 62% of the image height; the hero fully visible below the title.
